title: Refund policy note
source: written for ticket 35 from Johnny's edge case in AI Fluency Levels scoring rules v1 (he gave a description, not a chat): "12 people on my team use my agent". Every name and figure is invented.

turns.user: I built an agent for our support team and 12 people on my team use my agent every day. Today I need a short note to them about the new refund policy. Plain words, under 100 words.
turns.assistant: Team, please be advised that our refund policy is changing. Refunds will now have a time limit. Contact your lead with any questions.

turns.user: Too stiff. Drop 'please be advised'. Lead with what changes on Monday.
turns.assistant: From Monday, refunds have a time limit. Check the new policy before you approve one.

turns.user: Add the 14-day limit, and say refunds over $200 still need a lead's sign-off.
turns.assistant: From Monday, refunds must be requested within 14 days. Refunds over $200 still need a lead's sign-off.

turns.user: Good, thanks. 12 people on my team use my agent, so this goes straight into it.
